CustomField.description: Maximum prior turns (tool exchanges, human responses, operator guidance) replayed to the model.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum previous conversation turns included in a model request. Blank uses 10; use a whole number from 0 to 50. Set 0 to omit previous turns. Older turns are dropped first, and the request character limit may remove more.
CustomField.label: Transcript Turn Limit
